findings.evidence: "...(including FastAPI, springdoc or NestJS output)... Keywords: OpenAPI 3.0, components/schemas, types/api.ts, type guard." The Keywords line repeats terms already in the text, the length is close to the 1024 limit, and FastAPI is offered as a trigger even though its 0.99+ default (3.1) is refused
findings.fix: Convert OpenAPI 3.0.x JSON/YAML specs into TypeScript types for components/schemas and each operation's parameters, request body and responses, plus runtime type guards on request; Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.1 input (the FastAPI 0.99+ default) is detected and refused with the reason. Use when generating frontend or SDK types from openapi.yaml/openapi.json (springdoc, NestJS or 3.0 FastAPI output), typing the endpoints under paths, updating types/api.ts after the spec changed, or deciding how nullable, readOnly/writeOnly, oneOf/discriminator, allOf, additionalProperties or $ref map to TS, even when the user only says 'API types', 'typed responses' or 'type guard'. Not for standalone JSON Schema or Zod conversion, non-TypeScript targets, HTTP clients, mock servers, or validating a spec without emitting types.
